title: Red Steel 2
subtitle: A sword and a revolver share the view
summary: Red Steel 2 is Ubisoft Paris' Wii first-person action game combining sword fighting and gunplay in a stylised setting that mixes western towns with samurai traditions. body: Red Steel 2 is Ubisoft Paris' Wii first-person action game combining sword fighting and gunplay in a stylised setting that mixes western towns with samurai traditions. The player follows the last surviving Kusagari warrior through Caldera, confronting enemies with both a firearm and a blade. MotionPlus is required, allowing the direction and force of a swing to matter during close combat. The new setting stands apart from the first Red Steel's story, building its identity around a fighter who can move between shooting and a physical exchange of sword strikes.

Different opponents resist attacks in different ways. A defensive blade position can require a particular direction of slash, while heavy armour must be broken with forceful swings. Successful sequences can stun a foe and create an opening for a finishing gesture. The player therefore has to read the enemy before committing to another attack. Gunfire and sword techniques occupy the same encounter, giving distance and vulnerability practical importance. A confident response comes from recognising which action will open the opponent rather than repeating the same movement regardless of its effect.

Safe houses offer new moves, weapons and armour, along with wanted posters that lead to optional work. Purchasing a technique sends the player to a training area to practise its required sequence, connecting an upgrade with the movement needed to use it. Money earned through combat and exploration finances further improvements, while replayable challenges provide another opportunity to develop those skills. The structure breaks the action into expeditions and preparation, giving the increasingly capable warrior a place to rehearse before returning to the next group of opponents in Caldera.
